The '''amulet of glory''' is a [[dragonstone amulet]] that has been enchanted by the [[Lvl-5 Enchant]] spell. After completion of [[Heroes' Quest]], it can be charged at the [[Fountain of Heroes]] and the [[Fountain of Rune]]. When charged at the Fountain of Rune they will have 6 charges instead of the normal 4. With the completion of [[Dragon Slayer II]], it can be charged at the [[Fountain of Uhld]] below the [[Myths' Guild]]. The amulet of glory is tradeable on the [[Grand Exchange]] only when it has zero, four, or six charges.

It is a very popular amulet in [[members]]-only worlds amongst players of all levels, as it provides good damage bonuses, has no requirements to wear, is much less expensive than the [[amulet of fury]], and offers useful [[teleport]]s.

Like other dragonstone jewellery, it is one of the [[Wilderness#Member_teleportation_up_to_level_30_Wilderness|few items]] with a teleportation ability that will work up to level 30 Wilderness, while most other means of teleportation will not work above level 20 Wilderness.

A trimmed version, the [[amulet of glory (t)]], may be obtained from hard [[Treasure Trails]], but is no different than a normal amulet of glory aside from appearance and the inability to use it for certain Treasure Trail steps.

Certain Treasure Trail clue steps in the Hard, Elite and Master tiers require having an amulet of glory equipped, which can be difficult for [[ironmen]], given the very high Crafting level of 80 required. However, this can be somewhat alleviated by using a [[mushroom pie]] to temporarily boost Crafting by 4 levels, meaning an actual Crafting level of 76 is required for these clue steps.
